headline: KPMG Australia Cuts 230 Jobs Amid Demand Slump and Scandal
summary: KPMG Australia laid off 230 staff as large white-collar advisory employers across the country cut headcounts and off-shore tasks amid client spending cutbacks and whistleblower scrutiny.
why: The Big Four consulting firms in Australia face sustained revenue headwinds following federal government curbs on private consulting contracts and corporate belt-tightening.

impacts.name: Australian Professional Services
impacts.why: Job cuts reflect contracting demand for management consulting and audit services.
